relationship: One grouped distribution is represented by histogram bar areas and cumulative-frequency growth, so changing an interval affects both displays and quartile read-offs.
rationale: The canonical lesson preserves the guided build, cumulative read-off and comparison sequence, then adds one compact fresh-report path late in the experience so learners must own density, rank and IQR calculations on unequal-width data.

learnerLoop.action: Build intervals, read quartiles and alter a histogram bar.
learnerLoop.modelChange: Frequency density, bar area, cumulative totals and quartile estimates update together.
learnerLoop.evidence: The linked histogram, curve, highlights and working checks expose the same grouped data.
learnerLoop.nextDecision: Use the linked representation to locate the next quartile or explain the IQR.

invariants: Histogram area represents frequency even when class widths differ.
Cumulative frequency never decreases and ends at the total frequency.
Within-group cumulative read-offs use constant density and remain estimates.
Changing the report revision clears earlier density, total, rank and IQR checks.
safeAdaptations: Vary valid grouped intervals and frequencies while retaining linked displays.
Use five or six unequal-width groups in the bounded fresh-report path.
Change working support without disconnecting quartile evidence from the cumulative curve.
nonGoals: Using bar height alone as frequency for unequal-width classes.
Expanding the experience into unrelated statistics or permanently visible practice controls.

task.description: Current grouped-data task and concise stage prompt.
task.visibility: Shown for the current guided stage or fresh report.

model.description: Author-built unequal-width bars, cumulative graph, read-off ruler and comparison traces.
model.visibility: Present for the current report; controls follow the current stage.

working.description: Density, cumulative-total, quartile-rank and IQR entries tied to the same report revision.
working.visibility: Guided working stays concise; fresh-report fields appear one stage at a time late in the experience.

evidence.description: Bar areas, cumulative growth, quartile highlights and saved reports preserve the model relationship.
evidence.visibility: Updates as the report is constructed, read and compared.

completion.description: Feedback and continuation after the current bars, totals or read-offs satisfy the guided condition.
completion.visibility: Persistent dock with completion state supplied by the shared runtime.

controls.description: Current-stage bar or cumulative controls, saved report actions and the late fresh-report entry point.
controls.visibility: New report appears only in the experiment or completed fresh-report context.

grouped-data.description: Supplied or generated unequal class boundaries and class frequencies.
grouped-data.domain: Journey time in minutes and frequency in pupils.
grouped-data.source: The guided report or one bounded replayable fresh report.
grouped-data.output: Current boundaries, bars and completed history rows are visible.

density-total.description: Per-class density and cumulative total are distinct linked quantities.
density-total.domain: Pupils per minute and cumulative pupils.
density-total.source: Bar area and running-total checks for the current report revision.
density-total.output: Density controls bar height; cumulative totals control the curve rise.

quartile-rank.description: Q1, median and Q3 ranks are 25%, 50% and 75% of the report total.
quartile-rank.source: The same cumulative total used by the report curve.
quartile-rank.output: Rank check gates each fresh-report read-off.

quartiles-iqr.description: Three grouped read-offs and their derived interquartile range.
quartiles-iqr.source: Constant-density interpolation within the containing group.
quartiles-iqr.output: Accepted read-offs and Q3 − Q1 bracket.

modes.none: Guided stages show area, density and cumulative relationships while controls support construction.
modes.some: Density is entered or manipulated while cumulative rises and read-offs remain visibly linked to the bars.
modes.all: The guided sequence requires all bar areas, cumulative totals, three quartile estimates and the IQR.
modes.experiment: Saved reports remain comparable on their own boundary sets; a compact New report path uses one validated five- or six-group unequal-width report and stages density, cumulative total, quartile rank/read-off and IQR ownership.

dependencies: A bar area is frequency density multiplied by its class width; every cumulative rise equals one bar area.
Each fresh report is generated from one boundary/count model, and a new report revision clears all previous checks.
Quartile rank checks precede ruler recording, and Q3 follows Q1 and the median before IQR can be checked.
Saved comparisons retain each report's boundary set and label the same model quantities rather than normalising unrelated axes.
implementation.completion: The shared runtime advances after the current guided construction or the bounded fresh-report sequence has checked linked areas, totals, ranks/read-offs and IQR.
limitations: Within-group quartiles are estimates under constant density; the model does not claim individual journey times.
The fresh-report controls are staged and optional, so the guided introduction remains compact.
